title.zh: Microsoft’s Mustafa Suleyman says its AI outperforms doctors on hard cases as he chases ‘medical superintelligence’
title.en: Microsoft’s Mustafa Suleyman says its AI outperforms doctors on hard cases as he chases ‘medical superintelligence’

current_state.zh: A Science study found Microsoft's new AI diagnostic system beat generalist doctors on difficult medical cases, though most of the improvement was attributed to the underlying AI models rather than Microsoft's system itself.
current_state.en: A Science study found Microsoft's new AI diagnostic system beat generalist doctors on difficult medical cases, though most of the improvement was attributed to the underlying AI models rather than Microsoft's system itself.
